agent.description: Sample generative agent: a playbook with instructions, examples, an OpenAPI tool and a hand-off flow.

tools.description: Look up flight availability and fares.

openApiSpec.textSchema:
openapi: 3.0.0
info:
  title: Flights API
  version: "1.0"
servers:
  - url: http://127.0.0.1:9099/api
paths:
  /flights:
    get:
      operationId: searchFlights
      parameters:
        - name: destination
          in: query
          required: true
          schema: { type: string }
        - name: date
          in: query
          schema: { type: string }

playbooks.goal: Help travellers search flights, answer baggage questions and hand off to a human when asked.

steps.text: Greet the traveller and ask where they want to go.
To find flights, use ${TOOL:flights} with the destination and date.
If the traveller asks for a person, hand off to the Human Handoff flow.

userUtterance.text: I want to fly to Lisbon

agentUtterance.text: Lovely choice! What date would you like to travel to Lisbon?
The cheapest flight to Lisbon next Friday is 89 EUR. Shall I hold it for you?
Done — your seat is on hold for 24 hours. Have a great trip!

userUtterance.text: how much baggage can I bring

agentUtterance.text: You can bring one cabin bag up to 10kg and one checked bag up to 23kg.

userUtterance.text: I want to talk to a real person

text: Connecting you to a travel specialist now.

text.text: how much luggage can I bring?

text: You can bring one cabin bag up to 10kg and one checked bag up to 23kg.
